As a Test Chapter Lead at Valeo, I oversee testing practices across multiple squads within GISACC, ensuring adherence to best practices and driving efficiency through initiatives like GenAI integration. My role involves standardizing test processes, defining strategies, and mentoring team members to foster growth and high performance.

Responsibilities/Achievements:

  • Defined the testing vision and strategic roadmap for the GISACC department, aligning initiatives with organizational goals.
  • Governed testing practices across multiple squads through regular audits and feedback sessions to ensure adherence to standards.
  • Provided strategic support to squads by defining tailored test, automation, and performance strategies.
  • Organized and managed a portfolio of testing initiatives, ensuring continuous improvement and adoption of cutting-edge technologies and processes (e.g., GenAI).
  • Mentored and coached a team of 40+ testing professionals, resulting in a 50% improvement in overall team performance.
  • Led Test Automation and DevOps Initiatives across the department, achieving +10K EUR savings in 2024.
  • Led prioritization and planning for 15+ concurrent testing initiatives, ensuring alignment with project timelines.
  • Leveraged testing metrics and feedback loops to reduce defect leakage by 60% and improve testing cycle time by 40%.
  • Integrated GenAI-powered testing accelerators, saving over 200 hours.
  • Established a Centralized Test Automation Solution, resulting in over 90% savings.
  • Developed reusable automation frameworks, reducing script creation time by 25%.

As a Test Manager at Valeo, I oversee diverse projects and lead the Digital Solutions Testing team across various accounts. My role involves standardizing test processes and strategies across the department, supporting teams in Cairo and Chennai. Additionally, I mentor team members to help them achieve their personal and professional objectives successfully.

Responsibilities:

  • Guide and support staff in their career development, offering planning and growth opportunities.
  • Manage, instruct, and delegate tasks to team members effectively.
  • Standardize test processes and strategies across the department to ensure consistency and quality.
  • Support and collaborate with testing teams in Cairo and Chennai.
  • Enhance and implement testing processes for new and existing products to fulfill client requirements.
  • Estimate, prioritize, and plan testing activities to ensure smooth execution.
  • Analyze requirements, specifications, and technical design documents to offer prompt and insightful feedback.
  • Develop detailed, comprehensive, and well-organized test plans.
  • Conduct System Integration Testing with external systems.
  • Create, develop, and run automation scripts utilizing Selenium WebDriver.
  • Perform performance testing to ensure system stability, scalability, and efficiency.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, including Developers, Delivery Leads, and Product Owners, to determine system requirements.

As a Software Test Engineer with uTest/Applause, I work with a wide variety of companies to ensure their success when releasing their Products to the General Public.
